# GitHub Copilot instructions

<copilot>
Read and follow `AGENTS.md` at the Git root. Apply its memory rules for reading, verification, updates, and permission to set up memory. In a new repository, ask whether to enable the workflow and whether to track the files or put them in `.gitignore` before writing them. This Aider repository already uses versioned `FACTS.md` and `REASONING_BANK.md`.

When delegating, include the relevant repository rules and memory paths in each worker's prompt. The coordinating session verifies the combined work and records durable updates.
</copilot>
